## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor User
  participant FE as Frontend (Playground/CI)
  participant API as FastAPI
  participant WRK as Worker (Celery/Background)
  participant LLM as Providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama/Groq)
  participant DB as Postgres

  User->>FE: Start Playground / CI run
  FE->>API: POST /playground/run or POST /api/v1/ci/run
  API->>DB: persist TestResult(s)/batch (queued)
  API->>WRK: dispatch tasks (execute_test)
  WRK->>LLM: execute(prompt, model, timeout)
  LLM-->>WRK: output + usage
  WRK->>DB: update TestResult (status, latency, tokens, cost, score/is_correct)
  API->>DB: aggregate metrics, compare historical
  API-->>FE: results/status/final_status + justification
  FE->>User: render per-column outputs, metrics and analytics
```
